exposure: Placenta previa type at 28 weeks of gestation (complete, partial, marginal)
cohort: 368 pregnant women with 28th-week placenta previa from the Longitudinal Placenta Previa Study (LoPPS)
finding: Among pregnant women with placenta previa at 28 weeks of gestation, 62.5% still had previa at 36 weeks, with gestational hypertensive disorder, type of 28th-week previa, and number of prior cesarean sections significantly associated with resolution.
